codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of lib/factory-tokens.js following the codex-tokens.js pattern. Four exported functions (isFactoryTokenExpiring, refreshFactoryToken, persistFactoryTokens, ensureFreshFactoryToken) plus FACTORY_TOKEN_FIELDS map. The code correctly handles token expiry checking with JWT fallback, graceful refresh failure with API key fallback, label-based container persistence, and auth.v2 file writes for active accounts. 37 comprehensive tests covering all expectedBehavior items. Wired into both handleFactoryQuota and handleQuota factory sections. All 517 tests pass.

issues.description: Unused import: `normalizeEntryTokens` is imported from token-match.js but never used in the module. Only `updateEntryTokens` and `FACTORY_TOKEN_FIELDS` are actually referenced.

Unused parameter: `allAccounts` in `persistFactoryTokens(account, allAccounts, options)` is declared but never referenced in the function body. The function only uses `account` and `options`. It's forwarded from `ensureFreshFactoryToken` but serves no purpose in the persistence logic since Factory uses label-based matching (unlike codex-tokens.js which uses token-based matching).

Double container file read: `persistFactoryTokens` reads the container file once for updating accounts (lines 147-168) and again in the activeLabel IIFE (lines 171-176). Could be refactored to read once and extract both the accounts and activeLabel, avoiding redundant I/O.

Return value of `persistFactoryTokens()` is discarded in `ensureFreshFactoryToken`, meaning persistence errors are silently swallowed. This is consistent with codex-tokens.js's `ensureFreshToken` which also discards `persistOpenAiOAuthTokens` results, but callers have no way to know if persistence failed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission AGENTS.md states 'DO NOT call any Factory API endpoints other than /analytics/*', but the factory-token-refresh feature adds a POST to /api/v1/auth/refresh which is under /api/v1/auth/, not /analytics/. The feature spec explicitly requested this endpoint, so the AGENTS.md boundary constraint should be updated to also permit /api/v1/auth/refresh for token refresh.

summary: PASS. The factory-token-refresh feature is well-implemented with 4 exported functions and a field map, following the codex-tokens.js pattern closely. All 37 new tests are comprehensive and cover the full expectedBehavior spec including expiry checks, refresh success/failure, persistence, buffer window, and API key fallback. Four non-blocking issues found: unused import (normalizeEntryTokens), unused parameter (allAccounts in persistFactoryTokens), double container read, and discarded persistence result. One shared-state observation: AGENTS.md API boundary should be updated to permit the auth refresh endpoint.
